scales.name: discrepancy_size
scales.instructions: How far does the recorded value differ from the expected value?
levels: Matches expected value, or differs by under 2%
Differs from expected value by 2% to under 10%
Differs from expected value by 10% to under 25%
Differs from expected value by 25% or more

scales.name: failed_checks
scales.instructions: How many of the standard checks on this record failed?
levels: Two or three standard checks failed
Four or more standard checks failed

scales.name: recurrence_count
scales.instructions: How often has this same issue been logged in 12 months?
levels: First occurrence; not logged in prior 12 months
Logged once before within the past 12 months
Logged two to four times in 12 months
Logged five or more times in 12 months
